methods.what: Product of two structured 4x4 determinants rewritten by row/column permutations
Partial fraction / Lagrange interpolation decomposition over (y-α)(y-β)
Transformation of elliptic integrals of order n with modulus λ and multiplier M
Period division and ratio of periods under transformation
Product representation of 1-y via shifted sin am values
Division with remainder using integer part Σ(m/t)
Counting formula involving integer parts and remainders
